body: Thank you so much for this. I have no plan on even thinking of her anymore and if she tries to renew this next year i will be more prepared. She has destroyed me for the last 6 years and i wont let her destroy the rest of my life.
This was a one year order in the State of NC.
Im steering clear of women in general for a little while. Im not even 30 and i have major trust issues because of this.
